Karwar.desc: Karwar is a coastal city, taluka and the administrative headquarters of Uttara Kannada district, formerly part of the Bombay Presidency, located at the mouth of the Kali river along the Konkan Coast in the present-day state of Karnataka, India.

Gokarna.desc: A laid-back coastal town in Karnataka's Uttara Kannada district, famous for Om Beach, the Mahabaleshwar Temple and a string of beaches along the Arabian Sea. Popular with backpackers and road trippers, it sits roughly halfway down the western coast between Goa and Mangalore. (Wikipedia extract)
